sn47.5:1.3: akusalarāsīti bhikkhave, vadamāno pañcanīvaraṇe sammā vadamāno vadeyya.
sn47.5:1.4: kevaloha’yaṃ bhikkhave, akusalarāsi yadidaṃ pañca nīvaraṇā.
sn47.5:1.7: akusalarāsīti bhikkhave, vadamāno ime pañcanīvaraṇe sammā vadamāno vadeyya.
sn47.5:1.8: kevaloha’yaṃ bhikkhave, akusalarāsi, yadidaṃ pañca nīvaraṇā.
sn47.5:2.1: kusalarāsīti bhikkhave, vadamāno cattāro satipaṭṭhāne sammā vadamāno vadeyya.
sn47.5:2.2: kevaloha’yaṃ bhikkhave, kusalarāsi. yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā.
sn47.5:2.4: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.5:2.7: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.5:2.8: kusalarāsīti bhikkhave, vadamāno ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne sammā vadamāno vadeyya.
sn47.5:2.9: kevaloha’yaṃ bhikkhave, kusalarāsi yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānāti.
